cohort: Preterm piglets (n = 830 from 55 pregnant sows) delivered by caesarean section, categorized into moderate growth restriction (lowest 5-20% percentile birth weight) and litter-mate controls.
finding: Moderate fetal growth restriction in preterm pigs had limited effect on motor function and spatial memory in the early postnatal period, despite some initial delays in basic motor skills.
birth_weight: GR pigs: 728 ± 140 g; Control pigs: 1,019 ± 204 g
